name: Prison Of Sissy
source:
In this game, a young man accidentally uses feminine medications, leading to the development of feminine traits. In a desperate bid to escape this transformation and regain his former self, he needs a lot of money. After attempting to steal money, he ends up in prison, where the story unfolds, detailing how his femininity continues to evolve throughout the process.

[From [url=https://3kdesign.itch.io/prison-of-sissy]Itch.io[/url]]
